truth.affected_span_verbatim:
These results demonstrate that ML-based charge-jump detection is viable at the resource
and latency constraints of on-chip quantum firmware. The approach is supervision-free at
inference time, requires no hyperparameter tuning when applied to a new qubit, and
supports streaming deployment in the qubit control loop. Future work will focus on
deploying the DCCNN on real-time data acquisition with operating qubit hardware, validating
the simulation-trained model on measured scans and demonstrating in-loop integration with
the QICK control firmware.
